summary: Enhance your coding skills with our Python Programming Training Course. Learn from experts and master Python in a hands-on, interactive environment.
lede: Python programming helps professionals turn recurring analysis, reporting and file-based tasks into readable, tested code. It suits learners progressing from basic programming concepts toward intermediate practice, and develops skills in writing reusable functions, transforming data with pandas, and checking results through testing and debugging. Participants also work with files, SQLite, notebooks and Git to document and present a small Python solution.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to use Python programming in daily analysis, automation, reporting, software support, or early-stage application work. It suits learners progressing from foundation concepts toward intermediate practice, including people who have limited formal programming experience but can work with files, spreadsheets, or structured business processes.
modules: Python Control Flow and Data Structures
Python Files, APIs, and Data Persistence
prerequisites: No previous programming qualification is required. You should be comfortable using files, folders, spreadsheets, and a standard computer operating system. Basic logical reasoning helps, but the course introduces Python syntax from the beginning. Coding is required for completion through guided exercises, although you do not need prior Python experience. You need a laptop with Python, Jupyter Notebook, and either VS Code or another Python-compatible editor. The training team can provide setup guidance, practice datasets, and starter files. The course teaches advanced subjects such as API integration, testing architecture, and AI-assisted coding at operational application level rather than production engineering level.
